idea-plugin.name: Every Sync
idea-plugin.description: Project-scoped clipboard synchronization. VM is the business source of truth. One plugin, HOST/VM roles configured in Settings. Full/incremental Git bundles and authoritative HOST apply after explicit confirmation; receipt-based baselines. VM Git and outer workspace Git are never automatically committed or pushed. Separate Project Transfer and File Transfer tabs; binary single-file chunks with filename, SHA-256 verification and receiver-selected save location.
